comment: This is the one module in the pack with no left-to-right normalling: every other stereo module here falls back to the left input when the right jack is empty, and this one reads 0V (StereoWidth.cpp:24). Below the halfway point the two channels are crossfaded against their own average; above it the half-difference is added and subtracted, at full strength from 75% of the travel, with a gain of up to 2 on it beyond that (StereoWidth.cpp:38-45).
